name: parallax-depth
title: Parallax Depth
description: A layered landscape trucks sideways with a gentle push-in, near layers sliding faster than far ones. Built-in sun and hills preview on their own; a host adds its own full-frame layers by pushing an element and a depth (1 is nearest, larger moves less) onto LAYERS in the script.
useWhen: An opener or a quiet beat needs a cinematic establishing shot, a slow sideways camera move across a sun and hills.
You have a few flat layers and want them to read as one scene with real depth.
avoidWhen: The subject is a screenshot or long page the camera should travel across: use stage.
The subject should hold its size while the space behind it stretches: use dolly-zoom.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Sideways camera travel at depth 1, as a fraction of the frame width.

variables.label: Push-in
variables.description: Push-in toward the scene, in depth units.
